hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''); print(f)" | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*.php) rel=$(echo "$f" | sed 's|.*backend/||'); docker compose exec -T backend vendor/bin/pint "$rel" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; }
